episodios.titulo: 5 erros de inglês que todo brasileiro comete
temas: I am agree -> I agree
I have 20 years -> I am 20 years old
I pretend to travel -> I plan to travel
Actually = atualmente -> Currently · Nowadays
Can I make a question? -> Can I ask a question?
ensina: I plan to travel next year.

episodios.titulo: 5 falsos amigos do inglês que enganam todo brasileiro
temas: parents = parentes -> Parents = pais
push = puxar -> Push = empurrar
library = livraria -> Library = biblioteca
college = colégio -> College = faculdade
exquisite = esquisito -> Exquisite = requintado
ensina: I borrow books from the library.

episodios.titulo: 5 frases de inglês para o aeroporto e a imigração
temas: Motivo da viagem? 🛂 Passeio = vacation -> I'm here on vacation.
Gate = portão de embarque ✈️ -> Where is the gate?
Nada a declarar = nothing to declare 🧳 -> I have nothing to declare.
Layover = escala ⏱️ -> How long is the layover?
Luggage = bagagem 🧳 · suitcase = mala -> My luggage is lost.
ensina: I'm here on vacation for two weeks.
Excuse me, where is gate twelve?
I'm only carrying clothes and a few gifts.
The layover in Dallas is three hours.
My suitcase didn't arrive. Can you help me?

episodios.titulo: 5 palavras que o brasileiro pronuncia errado em inglês
temas: com-for-tá-bou -> comfortable
ve-ge-tá-bou -> vegetable
clô-tes -> clothes
xo-co-lá-te -> chocolate
re-cai-pi -> recipe

episodios.titulo: Como dizer 5 expressões brasileiras em inglês
temas: I have saudade of you -> I miss you
So much makes -> I don't mind.
Stay at will -> Make yourself at home
Good appetite -> Enjoy your meal
I have laziness -> I feel lazy
ensina: Pizza or pasta? Either is fine.

episodios.titulo: Inglês para crianças: cores e frutas
temas: apple = maçã, red = vermelho 🍎 -> The apple is red.
banana: escreve igual, mas o som muda 🍌 -> The banana is yellow.
grape = uva, purple = roxo 🍇 -> The grape is purple.
orange é a fruta E a cor. Duas coisas numa palavra só! 🍊 -> The orange is orange.
watermelon = melancia: verde por fora, vermelha por dentro 🍉 -> The watermelon is green.
ensina: It's green on the outside and red on the inside.

episodios.titulo: Inglês no restaurante: peça tudo sem passar vergonha
temas: diga quantas pessoas são + please 😊 -> Table for two, please.
I want a burger -> Can I get a burger, please?
no + ingrediente, ou “without” = sem 🧅 -> No onions, please.
I want the account -> Can we get the check, please?
to go = pra viagem 🥡 -> To go, please.
ensina: Do you have a table by the window?
Can I get a burger, please?
Can I get the chicken salad?
Can I get it without cheese?
Can we get the check, please?
Could we have the check, please?
Can I get a box for my leftovers?

episodios.titulo: 5 gírias que os jovens americanos usam
temas: no cap = sem mentira, de verdade 🧢 -> No cap, this pizza is amazing.
lowkey = meio que, no fundo 🤫 -> I'm lowkey tired today.
vibe = clima, energia ✨ -> I like the vibe here.
slay = arrasar 💅 -> You did great today. Slay!
bet = fechado, combinado 🤝 -> Bet! See you at six.
ensina: No cap, this pizza is amazing.
No cap, that movie was great.
This place has a great vibe.
Her dress is amazing. She slayed!

episodios.titulo: 5 erros com in, on e at que todo brasileiro comete
temas: in Monday -> on Monday
in eight o'clock -> at eight o'clock
on July -> in July
in home -> at home
at the morning -> in the morning

episodios.titulo: 5 phrasal verbs que os americanos usam todo dia
temas: get up = levantar da cama ⏰ -> I get up at six.
give up = desistir 💪 -> Never give up.
look for = procurar 🔍 -> I'm looking for my keys.
find out = descobrir 🕵️ -> Let's find out the truth.
turn off = desligar 💡 -> Please turn off the light.
ensina: I don't want to give up.
She is looking for a job.

episodios.titulo: 5 frases para arrasar na entrevista de emprego em inglês
temas: Tell me about yourself = fale sobre você -> Tell me about yourself.
strengths = pontos fortes 💪 -> What are your strengths?
Why this job? = por que essa vaga? -> Why do you want this job?
start = começar 🗓️ -> When can you start?
questions = perguntas ❓ -> Do you have any questions?
ensina: I'm a nurse with five years of experience.
I'm organized and I learn fast.
Why do you want this job?
I want to grow with your team.
I can start in two weeks.
Yes. What does a typical day look like?

episodios.titulo: Ensine ao seu filho: animais e sons em inglês
temas: dog = cachorro · woof = au au -> The dog says woof.
cat = gato · meow = miau -> The cat says meow.
cow = vaca · moo = muuu -> The cow says moo.
duck = pato · quack = quá quá -> The duck says quack.
pig = porco · oink = oinc -> The pig says oink.
ensina: The cow lives on a farm.
The duck swims in the lake.

temas: lunch = lanche -> Lunch = almoço
pull = pular -> Pull = puxar
novel = novela -> Novel = romance
assist = assistir -> Assist = ajudar
realize = realizar -> Realize = perceber
ensina: Pull the door to open it.
I didn't realize it was so late.

episodios.titulo: Como dizer 5 expressões do dia a dia em inglês
temas: I go to think -> I'll think about it.
What a feather! -> That's too bad.
Repeat, please -> Could you say that again?
I'm arriving -> I'm on my way.
It gave right -> It worked!
ensina: Great offer! I'll think about it.
You missed the bus? That's too bad.
Sorry, could you say that again?
Don't worry, I'm on my way.
I restarted my phone, and it worked!

episodios.titulo: Inglês no médico e na farmácia: diga o que você sente
temas: I have pain in the head -> I have a headache.
I have fever -> I have a fever.
I need a recipe -> I need a prescription.
I am allergic of penicillin -> I'm allergic to penicillin.
I am with a cold -> I have a cold.
ensina: I have a headache. Can I take something?
I have a fever and a cough.
The doctor gave me a prescription.
I have a cold and a sore throat.

I used to live
in Paris.

I need to do
my homework.

Can you lend me
your pen?

Currently, I work
at a bank.

Bring your friend
to my party!
